definition.name: Compiler observations plus six signed dotnet initializer and callback cases

steps.name: Fetch the exact historical native source before bounded verification
Install the normal captured compiler isolation boundary
steps.run:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install --yes bubblewrap libgdbm6t64 libreadline8t64 libsqlite3-0 liblttng-ust1t64 libtcl8.6 libtk8.6
sudo sysctl -w kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0

steps.name: Prepare the pinned compiler and small current closed-runtime adapters
steps.run:
curl --fail --location --max-time 180 \
  https://github.com/WebAssembly/wasi-sdk/releases/download/wasi-sdk-29/wasi-sdk-29.0-x86_64-linux.tar.gz \
  --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk.tar.gz"
printf '%s  %s\n' 87d1d1a2879d139cdc624b968efad3d4a97b8078cdff95e63ac88ecafd1a0171 "$RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check --strict
tar -xzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk.tar.gz" -C "$RUNNER_TEMP"
python3 tools/install_guest_bindgen.py "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-diagnostics-bindgen"
export PATH="$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-diagnostics-bindgen:$PATH"
printf '%s\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-diagnostics-bindgen" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
python3 tools/dotnet_capsule.py install-tools "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-diagnostics-tools" \
  --wasi-sdk "$RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk-29.0-x86_64-linux"

steps.name: Check passive collectors, source binding and finite runtime oracles
steps.run:
python3 -m pip install --requirement tools/requirements.lock
python3 -B -m unittest tools.tests.test_java_compiler_reachability tools.tests.test_dotnet_compiler_reachability tools.tests.test_compiler_compatibility_fixture tools.tests.test_compiler_compatibility_execution tools.tests.test_compiler_compatibility_workflows -v

steps.name: Authenticate the same five native products without rebuilding the host
Capture one substantive component and run exact compiler plus signed observations
Retain bounded public identities, actual results and signable package for causal replay
